<!-- llms.txt -->

# Panelize

> A React layout kit. Named boxes and type are the map of the screen. `createPanelizeTheme` + `PanelizeProvider` + `usePanelizeTheme` standardize paint. Forms are bonus.

This file is for agents **building apps and custom components with Panelize**. Maintainers of this repo: [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jayzizzle/panelize/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jayzizzle/panelize/blob/main/AGENTS.md). After `npm install panelize`, read `node_modules/panelize/llms.txt` (or the package export `panelize/llms.txt`). One-file dump: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

**Humans:** if you are setting up a project for an agent, run `npx panelize init-agents` from the project root. It adds a Panelize section to `AGENTS.md` that points agents here. See [Host setup](#host-setup).

Import from `'panelize'`. Wrap the host once with `PanelizeProvider`. Do not take over the host’s styled-components `ThemeProvider`. Do not set `html` / `body` from the library. Host CSS must give the shell a height (`html`, `body`, `#root { height: 100% }` for a filled app).

## How to compose (strict)

Read [docs/composition.md](docs/composition.md) before writing JSX. Summary:

- `Panels` is the **outer shell** of a view. Direct children are only `Panel` (one `Panel` is allowed).
- `Panel` is a **section**. It may contain tracks, `Div`, type, controls, nested `Panels`, and custom components. One item sits directly in it; several go in a track. It must not contain a stray `Row`, `Col`, or `Cell`.
- Track pairing is bidirectional. `Row` exists only as a direct child of `Rows`. `Col` only under `Cols`. `Cell` only under `Grid`. `Panels` holds only `Panel`. A `Panel` normally sits under `Panels`, and may also sit in a `Cell` / `Col` / `Row` when that spot needs its own surface (`variant`).
- `Rows` / `Cols` / `Grid` need **two or more** of their item. One band → put it in the `Panel` or a `Div`.
- The reverse holds too. **Two or more** items in a `Panel` or `Div` (heading, copy, button) go in `Rows` (stacked), `Cols` (side by side), or `Grid`, never loose siblings. The track owns order and `gap`.
- The **wrapper** owns place (`alignX` / `alignY`, `flex`, `fill`, `gap`, size). Nested controls and custom components do not position themselves.
- Visible copy goes in `Text` / `Heading` / `Span` / `TextLink` / `Label` so it inherits the nearest `Panel` text tokens.

The library does not warn at runtime if a host ignores this. Follow it anyway — that is how the tree stays readable.

## Core

- [Composition](docs/composition.md): pairing, who positions, good and bad trees, which primitive to use
- [Recipes](docs/recipes.md): copyable page, sidebar, centered card, form, dashboard grid, header/body/footer

- [Shell (`Panels` / `Panel`)](docs/shell.md): page vs split, `fill`, `scroll`, `horizontal`, `stack`
- [Layout vocabulary](docs/layout.md): `fill` vs `flex`, `gap`, `wrap`, `stack`, `Div`, `Grid`
- [Controls](docs/controls.md): per-control behavior notes (chrome, defaults, edge cases)
- [Accessibility](docs/accessibility.md): names, structure, keyboard, roles, focus

- [Theme and hooks](docs/theme.md): `createPanelizeTheme`, `PanelizeProvider`, `usePanelizeTheme`

## Bonus

- [Forms, buttons, chips](docs/forms.md): controls on top of the layout core, value ownership, `Select` / `MultiSelect`, validation

## Host setup

Agents only know about these docs if the host project points at them. From the project root, `npx panelize init-agents` adds a marked Panelize section to `AGENTS.md` (created if missing, otherwise appended; re-running updates only that section). Add `--cursor`, `--claude`, `--copilot`, or `--all` for tool-specific files, and `--dry-run` to preview.

By hand, copy the section from [examples/AGENTS.md](examples/AGENTS.md) into the host’s agent instructions (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, Copilot instructions, or a system prompt). Cursor users can also copy [examples/cursor-rule.mdc](examples/cursor-rule.mdc) to `.cursor/rules/panelize.mdc`.

## Human docs

- [README.md](README.md): install, quick start, fonts, goals, usage, vocabulary, caveats
- [examples/panelize.theme.md](examples/panelize.theme.md): every key `createPanelizeTheme` accepts

<!-- docs/composition.md -->

# Composition

Build views and custom components from layout primitives. The JSX should read as the picture without opening the browser.

## Pairing (bidirectional)

| Item    | Direct parent                                             | That parent’s direct children           |
| ------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `Panel` | `Panels`, or a `Cell` / `Col` / `Row` for its own surface | `Panels`: only `Panel` (one is allowed) |
| `Row`   | `Rows`                                                    | only `Row`, **two or more**             |
| `Col`   | `Cols`                                                    | only `Col`, **two or more**             |
| `Cell`  | `Grid`                                                    | only `Cell`, **two or more**            |

`Row` must not sit on `Panel`, `Div`, `Col`, `Cell`, or `Grid`. Same idea for `Col` and `Cell`. Fragments and `.map` still have to produce those children.

A `Panel` normally sits under `Panels`. It may also sit inside a `Cell`, `Col`, or `Row` when that spot needs its own surface (`variant`), as a dashboard tile does. If the content can use the surrounding surface, skip the `Panel` and put `Rows` / `Cols` straight in the `Cell`.

Custom components are **not** substitutes for `Row` / `Col` / `Cell`. Build them from primitives, then place the custom component inside a `Row`, `Col`, `Cell`, `Panel`, or `Div`.

## Shell → sections → tracks

1. `Panels` — outer shell of the view (`fill`, `scroll`, column vs `horizontal`).
2. `Panel` — sections (surfaces). One is fine. Several for nav + main, or stacked regions.
3. Inside a `Panel`: `Rows` / `Cols` / `Grid` / `Div` / nested `Panels` / type / controls / custom components.

A `Panel` is an **open** section. It is not a homogeneous track.

**One item** goes straight in the `Panel` or a `Div`. Do not wrap it in `Rows` of one `Row` (or `Cols` of one `Col`, or `Grid` of one `Cell`).

**Two or more items** (a heading, a line of copy, a button) belong in a track: `Rows` when they stack, `Cols` when they sit side by side, `Grid` when they sit in two dimensions. The track owns order, `gap`, and alignment. Loose siblings in a `Panel` or `Div` leave that to chance and make the JSX stop reading as the picture. The same goes for a `Div` with two or more children.

## Who positions

The wrapper layout box owns place. Set `alignX` / `alignY`, `flex`, `fill`, `gap`, `width` / `height` on `Panels`, `Panel`, `Rows`, `Row`, `Cols`, `Col`, `Grid`, `Cell`, or `Div` — not on `Text`, `Button`, or a custom widget so it can “nudge itself.”

`Text` / `Heading` / `Span` / `TextLink` / `Label` are not layout shells (no `fill` / `flex` / padding). Controls may take `fill` to stretch the control itself; the parent still decides where the control sits.

## Type

Visible writing uses `Text`, `Heading`, `Span`, `TextLink`, or `Label`. Bare strings in a `Panel` / `Row` / `Col` / `Div` do not pick up `--panelize-text` / muted / highlighted.

## Good

```tsx
<Panels fill scroll='vertical'>
  <Panel variant='muted' minHeight='100%'>
    <Rows minHeight='100%' gap='base' alignX='center' alignY='center'>
      <Row>
        <Heading level={1} color='primary'>
          Panelize
        </Heading>
      </Row>
      <Row>
        <Text muted>A React panel layout library.</Text>
      </Row>
      <Row>
        <Cols gap='small'>
          <Col>
            <Button label='Deploy now' />
          </Col>
          <Col>
            <Button outline label='Details' />
          </Col>
        </Cols>
      </Row>
    </Rows>
  </Panel>
</Panels>
```

Column of rows, last row is two columns of buttons. The `Cols` gap and the `Row` place the buttons; the buttons do not.

One section, one heading — no `Rows`:

```tsx
<Panels fill>
  <Panel variant='base' padding='base'>
    <Heading level={2}>Account</Heading>
  </Panel>
</Panels>
```

One section, several items — a `Rows` with one `Row` each:

```tsx
<Panels fill>
  <Panel variant='muted' padding='base'>
    <Rows>
      <Row>
        <Heading level={1}>Hello</Heading>
      </Row>
      <Row>
        <Text muted>Your first Panelize view.</Text>
      </Row>
      <Row>
        <Button label='Continue' />
      </Row>
    </Rows>
  </Panel>
</Panels>
```

## Bad

Each block is wrong. The comment says why.

```tsx
// Row is not a direct child of Rows
<Panel>
  <Row>
    <Text>Hello</Text>
  </Row>
</Panel>
```

```tsx
// Rows of one Row: put the content in the Panel or a Div
<Rows>
  <Row>
    <Text>Hello</Text>
  </Row>
</Rows>
```

```tsx
// Col is not a Rows child
<Rows>
  <Col>
    <Text>Hello</Text>
  </Col>
  <Row>
    <Text>World</Text>
  </Row>
</Rows>
```

```tsx
// Two or more items loose in a Panel: put them in Rows (stacked) or Cols (side by side)
<Panel>
  <Heading level={1}>Hello</Heading>
  <Text muted>Your first Panelize view.</Text>
  <Button label='Continue' />
</Panel>
```

```tsx
// Same for a Div with two or more children
<Div>
  <Text muted>Users</Text>
  <Heading level={3}>1,204</Heading>
</Div>
```

```tsx
// Copy is not in a type primitive, so it misses --panelize-text
<Panel>Hello</Panel>
```

```tsx
// A control positions itself. Button has no alignX
<Col>
  <Button alignX='center' label='Save' />
</Col>
```

Center with `alignX` on the wrapper (`Cols`, `Row`, `Panel`), not on `Button`.

## Which primitive?

| You want                    | Use                                                |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| The outer frame of a view   | `Panels`                                           |
| A surface (nav, main, card) | `Panel`                                            |
| A vertical list of bands    | `Rows` of two or more `Row`                        |
| A horizontal list of items  | `Cols` of two or more `Col`                        |
| A two-dimensional layout    | `Grid` of two or more `Cell`                       |
| One wrapper or one band     | `Div`, or the `Panel` itself                       |
| Two or more items in a box  | `Rows` / `Cols` / `Grid`, not loose in the box     |
| Words on screen             | `Text` / `Heading` / `Span` / `TextLink` / `Label` |
| Copyable starting points    | [recipes](recipes.md)                              |

---

<!-- docs/shell.md -->

# Shell (`Panels` / `Panel`)

`Panels` is the outer shell of a view. Setting it up well matters more than any control.

Default `Panels` is an **absolute** column (`inset` when `fill`). `relative` opt-in. `horizontal` is a row (sidebar + main). Overlay shells belong on `Panels`, not `Rows fill`.

Direct children: only `Panel`. **One `Panel` is allowed.** Nested shells: a `Panel` may contain another `Panels`. A `Panel` may also sit inside a `Cell` / `Col` / `Row` when that spot needs its own surface (`variant`).

`Panel` is a section (surface). `variant` is `muted` / `base` / `highlighted` (default `base`). It publishes `--panelize-bg`, `--panelize-text`, `--panelize-text-muted`, `--panelize-text-highlighted`, `--panelize-border`. Nested panels and children share those. `dark` / `light` are schemes on the provider, not panel variants.

## Host height

A filled shell needs a viewport-tall host:

```css
html,
body,
#root {
  height: 100%;
}
```

The library does not set `html` / `body`. For a long in-flow document, drop host `height` and use `min-height: 100%`.

## Page (scroll the shell)

Default column — do not add `horizontal`. Do not put `fill` on the inner `Panel` (that locks height). Use `minHeight='100%'` so a short window still paints. Do not center on the scrolling `Panels`; center on inner `Rows`.

```tsx
<Panels fill scroll='vertical'>
  <Panel variant='muted' minHeight='100%' padding='base'>
    <Rows gap='small'>
      <Row>
        <Heading level={1}>Title</Heading>
      </Row>
      <Row>
        <Text muted>Long page copy…</Text>
      </Row>
    </Rows>
  </Panel>
</Panels>
```

## Split (scroll the pane)

`horizontal` + `fill` on `Panels`. `scroll` on the pane `Panel`, not the outer shell. Sidebar: `width`. Main: `flex` (not `fill` — `fill` fights the sidebar). `stack` on this row: **at most** this wide → column (not Tailwind `md:` and-up).

```tsx
<Panels horizontal fill stack='sm'>
  <Panel variant='muted' width='12rem'>
    <Text>Nav</Text>
  </Panel>
  <Panel variant='base' flex scroll='vertical'>
    <Text>Main</Text>
  </Panel>
</Panels>
```

## `scroll`

Only on `Panels` and `Panel`. `vertical` clips x. `horizontal` / `both` need a child actually wider than the box (`width` / `minWidth` on children). Nested `scroll` in a split needs `flex` on the pane (`min-width` / `min-height` 0) so it can shrink.

`Panel` / `Row` / `Col` / `Div` are `flex-shrink: 0` until `flex`.

---

<!-- docs/layout.md -->

# Layout vocabulary

Space / size / border tokens: `none` | `extraSmall` | `small` | `base` | `large` | `extraLarge`. Breakpoints: `sm` | `md` | `lg`. Token or CSS length — not a unitless number. Boxes are `border-box`.

| Prop                      | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `fill`                    | Size to parent. Absolute `Panels`: `inset: 0`. Else height / width 100%. `Row` theme height `auto` → width 100% only. `Col` theme width `auto` → height 100% only. Explicit `width` / `height` win. Not on `Cell`. |
| `width` / `height`        | All layout except `Cell`. `Div` omit = unset.                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `flex`                    | `flex: 1 1 0%` plus `min-width` / `min-height` 0 (nested `scroll` can shrink). Not `fill`. `Panel` / `Row` / `Col` / `Div` are `flex-shrink: 0` until `flex`.                                                      |
| `alignX` / `alignY`       | Screen axes. Set on the **wrapper**. Track omit: flex cross `stretch` / main `start`; `Grid` `stretch` / `stretch`. Child omit: inherit.                                                                           |
| `gap`                     | `Panels`, `Rows`, `Cols`, `Grid`.                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `wrap`                    | `Rows` / `Cols`. Not `stack`. Not `Grid`.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `stack`                   | `horizontal` `Panels` / `Cols` / `Grid`. Container query, **at most** this wide → column.                                                                                                                          |
| `stackCols`               | `Grid` + `stack`: column count while stacked. Default 1.                                                                                                                                                           |
| `numCols` / `numRows`     | `Grid` only. Equal `minmax(0, 1fr)` tracks.                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `spanX` / `spanY`         | `Cell` only. Default 1. `stack` forces `spanX` to 1 when `stackCols` is 1.                                                                                                                                         |
| `scroll`                  | `Panels` / `Panel` only. See [shell](shell.md).                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `relative` / `horizontal` | `Panels` only.                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

## `Div`

Catch-all box (spacing, size, border, `fill` / `flex`). No background or color of its own. Use it when you need one wrapper and a `Rows` of one `Row` would be wrong. It holds **one** item. Two or more go in `Rows` / `Cols` / `Grid`. Direct children: anything except a stray `Row` / `Col` / `Cell` (those still belong under their tracks). No `gap`; spacing between items comes from the track.

## Tracks

Each tree stands alone. A track sits inside a `Panel`, and a `Panel` inside a `Panels`.

```tsx
<Panels fill>
  <Panel>
    <Rows gap='small' alignX='center'>
      <Row>
        <Text>One</Text>
      </Row>
      <Row>
        <Text>Two</Text>
      </Row>
    </Rows>
  </Panel>
</Panels>
```

```tsx
<Panels fill>
  <Panel>
    <Cols stack='sm' gap='small'>
      <Col width='12rem'>
        <Text>Side</Text>
      </Col>
      <Col flex>
        <Text>Main</Text>
      </Col>
    </Cols>
  </Panel>
</Panels>
```

```tsx
<Panels fill>
  <Panel>
    <Grid numCols={3} stackCols={2} gap='small' stack='sm'>
      <Cell>
        <Text>A</Text>
      </Cell>
      <Cell spanX={2}>
        <Text>B</Text>
      </Cell>
    </Grid>
  </Panel>
</Panels>
```

`Cell` has no `width` / `height` / `fill`. Size comes from the grid tracks and `spanX` / `spanY`. `Cell` is `min-width` / `min-height` 0 so content can shrink.

## Borders

Every layout box. Width cascade like padding: `borderWidth` → `borderX` / `Y` → side. `borderColor` is surface, brand, or status — not a `Panel` `variant`. Default width `none`.

---

<!-- docs/text.md -->

# Text

Visible copy must use a type primitive so it inherits the nearest `Panel` (`--panelize-text`, muted, highlighted) and theme type tokens.

| Component  | Element   | Notes                                                                                                                         |
| ---------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Text`     | `p`       | Body. Omit color → panel `text.base`.                                                                                         |
| `Heading`  | `h1`–`h6` | Required `level` `1`–`6`. Omit `size` → theme heading size for that level. Omit `weight` → `bold`. Omit `family` → `display`. |
| `Span`     | `span`    | Nested in `Text` / `Span`: omit size/weight/`family` → inherit. Omit color → CSS `inherit`.                                   |
| `TextLink` | `a`       | Default chroma `primary`. Nested omit size/weight/`family` → inherit.                                                         |
| `Label`    | `label`   | Caption for controls. Prefer `label` prop; `htmlFor` + control `id`. Wrap `Switch` / `Checkbox` / `Radio`.                    |

None of these is a layout shell: no `fill` / `flex` / padding. Spacing belongs on the parent: `gap` on `Rows` / `Cols` / `Grid`, or margin or padding on a `Row` / `Col` / `Cell` / `Div`.

`muted` / `highlighted` use the panel `text` object. `color='primary'` / `secondary` / `accent` → `brand.*.base`. `color='danger'` / `warning` / `success` / `info` → `status.*.base`. Raw CSS `color` wins. If both flags, `highlighted` wins.

Size: `fontSizes` tokens or CSS. Weight: omit on `Text` = `base` (400). Family: `base` / `display` / `mono`. The library does not load font files.

```tsx
<Heading level={1} uppercase color='primary'>
  Panelize
</Heading>
<Text muted size='small'>
  Nested <Span weight='bold'>bold</Span> and <TextLink href='/docs'>Docs</TextLink>
</Text>
```

---

<!-- docs/theme.md -->

# Theme and hooks

Appearance comes from the theme, not one-off color props on every box. That is how views stay standardized.

## `createPanelizeTheme`

Author schemes, surfaces, brand, type, and component defaults. Export a **stable** object. Omit any key to keep the library default. Full keys: [examples/panelize.theme.md](../examples/panelize.theme.md). Frozen gray bank: `palette` from `'panelize'` (not a theme key).

```ts
import { createPanelizeTheme, palette } from 'panelize'

export const panelizeTheme = createPanelizeTheme({
  colors: {
    dark: {
      app: { background: palette.gray.extraDark, text: palette.gray.extraLight },
      muted: {
        background: palette.gray.dark,
        text: { base: palette.white, muted: palette.gray.base, highlighted: palette.white },
      },
    },
  },
  brand: { primary: '#ff9f2e' },
})
```

`colors: { dark, light }` are schemes. After create, **`theme.colors` is the active slice** (`muted` / `base` / `highlighted` / `app`) — not `{ dark, light }`. Both maps are `theme.colorSchemes`. Surfaces belong under a scheme (`colors.dark.muted`). A top-level `colors.muted` is ignored. `dark` is a scheme, not a panel variant.

Brand (`primary` / `secondary` / `accent`) and status (`danger` / `warning` / `success` / `info`) are global, shared across schemes. Library `secondary` / `accent` follow `primary` until set. Status does not follow `primary`. Hosts set their brand kit here; the library defaults stay neutral.

## `PanelizeProvider`

Puts that object on the tree and wraps a canvas (`color-scheme` from `mode`; optional `app` paint). `mode` (`dark` default) selects the slice. Hosts own the toggle — there is no library toggle. `prefers-color-scheme` is host-side.

Do **not** take over the host’s styled-components `ThemeProvider`. Do **not** set `html` / `body`.

Without a provider, components still render using `defaultTheme` (`mode` `dark`). Always wrap a real host.

```tsx
<PanelizeProvider theme={panelizeTheme} mode={mode}>
  {children}
</PanelizeProvider>
```

## `usePanelizeTheme`

**Use this in views and custom components** that need colors, space, or type from the kit. `.colors` is the current scheme’s surfaces. `.mode` is `'dark'` | `'light'`. `.brand` / `.status` are the shared slots. `.space` / `.fontSizes` / … are the scales.

Do not invent a parallel palette in a custom component. Read the theme (or inherit `--panelize-*` from the nearest `Panel`). Nested `Panel` `variant` changes the CSS variables for descendants.

```tsx
function Stat({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  const { colors } = usePanelizeTheme()
  return (
    <Div padding='small' borderWidth='extraSmall' borderColor={colors.base.border}>
      <Rows>
        <Row>
          <Text muted size='small'>
            {label}
          </Text>
        </Row>
        <Row>
          <Text highlighted>{value}</Text>
        </Row>
      </Rows>
    </Div>
  )
}
```

Place `Stat` in a `Col` / `Row` / `Cell` / `Panel`. `Stat` does not take `alignX`.

## Recipes

Author the theme once in the host, export a stable object, and pass `mode` from wherever the host keeps its color-scheme state. The library has no toggle and does not read `prefers-color-scheme`.

**Brand kit.** `secondary` and `accent` follow `primary` until set. Status colors do not follow brand.

```ts
export const panelizeTheme = createPanelizeTheme({
  brand: {
    primary: '#6d5dfc',
    secondary: '#00b8a9',
    accent: { base: '#f9c80e', hover: '#ffd84d' },
  },
  status: { danger: '#d64550' },
})
```

**Both schemes.** Author `dark` and `light` surfaces together. Omit any surface to keep the default.

```ts
createPanelizeTheme({
  colors: {
    dark: { app: { background: '#0e0e10', text: '#ececec' } },
    light: {
      app: { background: '#ffffff', text: '#1a1a1a' },
      muted: {
        background: '#f3f3f5',
        text: { base: '#1a1a1a', muted: '#6b6b73', highlighted: '#000000' },
      },
    },
  },
})
```

**Fonts and type scale.** The library does not load font files. Point the tokens at what the host loads.

```ts
createPanelizeTheme({
  fontFamilies: { base: 'Inter, sans-serif', display: '"Fraunces", serif' },
  fontSizes: { base: '1.0625rem' },
})
```

**Component defaults.** Change a control everywhere instead of on every instance. `defaults.textarea` and `defaults.select` start from the merged `defaults.input`.

```ts
createPanelizeTheme({
  defaults: {
    button: { borderRadius: 'small', paddingX: 'large' },
    input: { borderRadius: 'small' },
    select: { listMaxHeight: '12rem' },
  },
})
```

**Custom component on the theme.** Read `usePanelizeTheme` or inherit `--panelize-*` from the nearest `Panel`; do not hard-code hexes. See `Stat` above.

---

<!-- docs/forms.md -->

# Forms, buttons, chips (bonus)

Core is layout + text. These controls exist so a host can ship a complete kit. Still compose them **inside** a `Panel` / `Row` / `Col` / `Cell` / `Div`. One control sits directly in its wrapper; several go in a `Rows` / `Cols`. The wrapper places them.

Per-control behavior notes: [controls](controls.md). Full prop list: exported types in `node_modules/panelize/dist/index.d.ts` (JSDoc on every prop). Human detail: [README.md](../README.md). Copyable field layout: [recipes](recipes.md#form-fields). Keyboard and labelling rules: [accessibility](accessibility.md).

- `Button` — `label` preferred; `children` win. `color` is the chroma slot. `outline` stays hollow. `fill` stretches the button, not a panel.
- `Chip` — badge, not a button. No hover.
- `Input` / `NumberInput` / `Textarea` — field chrome. Instance `color` is **focus** chroma, not glyph ink (`ink`). Prefer `Label` + `htmlFor`.
- `Select` / `MultiSelect` — custom listboxes, not native `<select>`. Host `value` / `onChange`. `MultiSelect` is a count in the field (`N selected`), not chips.
- `Switch` / `Checkbox` / `Radio` — wrap with `Label` (same `size`). Empty checkbox/radio stroke follows the label (`currentColor`).
- `Label` — type-like ink; not a layout shell.

Do not add `alignX` / `flex` / padding-as-layout on these to position them. Use a `Col` / `Row` / `Div`.

## Value ownership

The host owns every value. Nothing here keeps state you did not ask for.

| Control               | Controlled                                                                                      | Uncontrolled     |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| `Input` etc.          | `value` + `onChange(event)`                                                                     | `defaultValue`   |
| `NumberInput`         | `value` + `onChange(event)`; read `event.currentTarget.valueAsNumber` (the `value` is a string) | `defaultValue`   |
| `Select`              | `value: string` + `onChange(value: string)`                                                     | not offered      |
| `MultiSelect`         | `value: string[]` + `onChange(value: string[])`                                                 | not offered      |
| `Switch` / `Checkbox` | `checked` + `onChange(event)`                                                                   | `defaultChecked` |
| `Radio`               | `name` + `value` + `checked` + `onChange(event)`                                                | `defaultChecked` |

`Select` / `MultiSelect` call `onChange` with plain values, not events. Cleared is `''` (`Select`) or `[]` (`MultiSelect`). A `value` that has no matching option is still shown.

## `Select` and `MultiSelect`

```tsx
<Rows gap='extraSmall'>
  <Row>
    <Label htmlFor='country' label='Country' />
  </Row>
  <Row>
    <Select id='country' value={country} onChange={setCountry} placeholder='Choose' clearable>
      <Option value='us'>United States</Option>
      <Option value='mx' disabled>
        Mexico
      </Option>
    </Select>
  </Row>
</Rows>
```

- Options: `<Option value>` children and/or `options={[{ value, label, disabled? }]}`. Children win on a duplicate `value`.
- The menu renders in a portal on `document.body` (`position: fixed`). A scrolling `Panels` does not clip it. It sits at `defaults.select.listZIndex` (default 1100); raise that in the theme if a host overlay covers it.
- `clearable` shows ×. `required` blocks an empty value and disables clearing. `selectedAtTop` lists the selected option(s) first. `Select` also has `emptyOption`. `readOnly` opens to inspect without changing.
- `name` writes hidden input(s) so a native `<form>` submits the value. `MultiSelect` writes one input per value.
- `open` / `onOpenChange` control the menu. Omit for internal state.
- `MultiSelect` stays open while toggling and shows `N selected`. The caption is English-only.
- No native fallback, optgroups, or typing into the field.

## `Switch`, `Checkbox`, `Radio`

Wrap the control in a `Label` and give both the same `size`. A sibling caption works only with `htmlFor`, and a `disabled` control then cannot dim its label.

```tsx
<Label size='small'>
  <Checkbox size='small' checked={agree} onChange={(e) => setAgree(e.currentTarget.checked)} /> I
  agree
</Label>
```

`Checkbox` supports `indeterminate` (the native property; it does not set `checked`). A `Radio` group shares `name`; the host decides which `value` is checked.

## Validation

`Input` / `NumberInput` / `Textarea` / `Select` paint `status.danger` for `:user-invalid` (after the user edits) and for `aria-invalid='true'`. Set `aria-invalid` yourself for submit-time errors. Show the message in a `Text color='danger'` and tie it to the field with `aria-describedby`.

---

<!-- docs/accessibility.md -->

# Accessibility

What Panelize does for you, and what the host must still do.

## Names

Every control needs an accessible name. Use a `Label` with `htmlFor` matching the control `id`, or wrap the control in a `Label`. With no visible text, use `aria-label`. A `placeholder` is not a name.

- `Input` / `NumberInput` / `Textarea` / `Select` / `MultiSelect`: `Label htmlFor` + `id`, else `aria-label`.
- `Switch` / `Checkbox` / `Radio`: wrap in a `Label` (same `size`). These have no `label` prop.
- `Button`: `label`, or `children` with text. Icon-only: `aria-label`.
- `Chip` is not interactive. Do not use it as a button.

## Structure

- `Heading` needs `level` and renders `h1`–`h6`. Pick the level for the document outline, not for size (`size` is separate).
- `Panels` / `Panel` / `Rows` / `Cols` / `Grid` are plain `div`s. They add no landmarks or roles. Wrap them in `header` / `nav` / `main` / `section` in the host.
- Copy goes in `Text` / `Heading` / `Span` / `TextLink` / `Label` (real `p` / `h*` / `span` / `a` / `label`).

## Keyboard

| Control               | Keys                                                                                                                                      |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Select`              | Arrows move, Enter / Space pick, Home / End, type-ahead, Escape closes, Backspace / Delete clears when `clearable`, Tab leaves and closes |
| `MultiSelect`         | Same, but Enter / Space toggle. Type-ahead on a closed field opens and highlights                                                         |
| `Switch` / `Checkbox` | Space toggles                                                                                                                             |
| `Radio`               | Arrow keys move within a `name` group                                                                                                     |
| `Button` / `TextLink` | Native                                                                                                                                    |

Disabled options are skipped. Escape is handled on the trigger, not on `window`.

## Roles and state

- `Select` / `MultiSelect`: trigger is `role='combobox'` with `aria-haspopup='listbox'`, `aria-expanded`, and `aria-autocomplete='none'`. The menu is `role='listbox'` with `role='option'` rows. The listbox is labelled by the control only when you set `id`. `readOnly` sets `aria-readonly`.
- `Switch` is `input[type=checkbox][role=switch]`.
- Invalid fields: set `aria-invalid='true'`. The library paints it and `:user-invalid`. Link the error text with `aria-describedby`.

## Focus and contrast

- Focus is `:focus-visible` only: fields ring and glow in their `color`, `TextLink` uses a `currentColor` outline, switches / checkboxes / radios glow in the on-state chroma.
- `disabled` controls dim and are not focusable. `readOnly` on `Select` / `MultiSelect` stays full contrast.
- Contrast is the host’s job. The default theme is dark first. `palette` adjacent steps are **not** a safe text-on-fill pair; skip a step. Default `warning` (`#ffd60a`) is weak as small text on light panels. Check any custom `createPanelizeTheme` colors.
- `PanelizeProvider` sets CSS `color-scheme` from `mode` so native scrollbars and form chrome match. Respecting `prefers-color-scheme` or `prefers-reduced-motion` is host-side.

---

<!-- docs/controls.md -->

# Controls

Behavior notes for each control: chrome, defaults, edge cases. Props are in `node_modules/panelize/dist/index.d.ts`. Examples live in the [README](../README.md#controls). Value ownership and validation: [forms](forms.md). Labelling and keyboard: [accessibility](accessibility.md).

## Button

`<button type="button">`. Caption: `label` (preferred). Custom insides: `children` (`Cols` / `Text` / host icons) — they win if both are set. A string as `children` still works; don’t prefer it. No visible text: `aria-label`. Omit chrome = filled chroma; `outline` = border + slot label, hollow at rest/hover/active. `color` is the chroma slot (`primary` / `secondary` / `accent` / `danger` / `warning` / `success` / `info`) for rest, hover, and active (outline border stays on this slot). Filled ink is `defaults.button.ink` (library `palette.black`), not chroma-on-fill. `size` is font size; `fill` is the box (100% of parent). Native `disabled` dims and skips hover. Instance `padding` / `paddingX` / `paddingY` / `borderWidth` / `borderRadius` override the theme. `background` / `ink` are a token/CSS (all steps) or `{ base, hover, active }`; omitted keys keep the slot / black ink / transparent outline. `background` on `outline` opts in to fill. No margin.

## Chip

`<span>` badge. Label is the chroma slot (`primary` / `secondary` / `accent` / `danger` / …). Fill is `color-mix` of that chroma at `defaults.chip.tint` (`12%`) into the nearest panel `--panelize-bg` until `background`. Capsule radius until `borderRadius`. `borderWidth` default `none`. Caption: `label` (preferred); `children` win. Instance `ink` / `borderColor` / `background` are surface / brand / status / CSS. `base` on those is the panel `base` surface (fill vs text vs border by prop), not a brand slot. Not a layout shell.

## Input

`<input type="text">` unless `type` is set. Rest chrome is the nearest `Panel` (bg, text, border, muted placeholder). **`color` is focus chroma only** (caret, border, glow) — not the typed text (`ink`). Instance `background` / `ink` / `borderColor` override rest fill, glyphs, and rest stroke (surface / brand / status / CSS). `base` means that surface’s fill, `text.base`, or `border` depending on the prop. Instance `borderWidth` / `borderRadius` override the theme. Focus / `:user-invalid` still own the stroke. After the user has edited, `:user-invalid` paints `status.danger` (same 2px / 18% glow, caret included). Hosts can also set `aria-invalid="true"` for submit-time paint without a prior edit. Pair a visible name with `Label htmlFor`; placeholder-only still needs `aria-label`. Native HTML `size` is omitted; `size` is font size. `fill` is the box. `ref` works as a normal prop. Host owns the value. `readOnly` dims like `disabled` but keeps a text cursor.

## NumberInput

`Input` locked to `type="number"`. Same chrome (`css`, `background`, `ink`, `borderColor`, `:user-invalid` / `aria-invalid`). Native `min` / `max` / `step` (`step='any'` allowed). No `type` prop. UA stepper arrows are hidden (`appearance: none`); bounds and step are the API. `onChange` still gives a string — use `event.currentTarget.valueAsNumber`. Wheel over the field blurs so the value does not accidentally step. Prefer `NumberInput` over `<Input type='number'>`.

## Textarea

Same field chrome as `Input` (`<textarea>`), including `:user-invalid` / `aria-invalid`. Theme field keys inherit `defaults.input` unless `defaults.textarea` overrides them. Default `rows={3}`. Resize is off until `resize`. `fill` stretches the box and does not lock resize.

## Select

Custom listbox (not a native `<select>`). Trigger uses the same field chrome as `Input` (`background` / `ink` / `borderColor` / `aria-invalid`). Theme field keys inherit `defaults.input` unless `defaults.select` overrides them (`listMaxHeight` / `listOffset` / option padding / `listZIndex` / `listShadow`). The menu portals to `document.body` (`position: fixed`) so a scrolling `Panels` does not clip it. Host owns `value` / `onChange` (`(value: string) => void`; empty string when cleared). A value that is not in `options` still shows (raw `value`) and can be cleared. Omit `open` for internal open state, or pass `open` + `onOpenChange`. Options: `options={{ value, label, disabled? }[]}` and/or child `<Option value>` (children win on the same `value`). `placeholder` when empty (muted). `required` blocks clearing to empty and marks the hidden input `required`. `clearable` shows an × when there is a value (ignored when `required`). `selectedAtTop` lists the selected option first in the menu (the `emptyOption` row stays first). `emptyOption` adds a first row with value `''` (`true` uses `placeholder`; a string is the caption; ignored when `required`). `readOnly` opens to inspect without pick / clear (not dimmed). Without `required`, clicking the selected option deselects it. `name` writes a hidden input for form submit (`disabled` when the select is). Pointer: pick, clear, caret-toggle close, and click-outside **blur** the trigger (no open ring). Keyboard pick / Escape keep focus. Tab away closes the menu. Keyboard: arrows, Enter, Space, Escape on the trigger (not `window`), Home, End, type-ahead; Backspace / Delete clears when clearable. `aria-autocomplete="none"`. The listbox uses `aria-labelledby` only when `id` is set. Disabled options are skipped. CSS chevron on the trigger; the value and rest option labels share highlighted ink. The selected option uses `color` (primary) for the label plus a CSS check, with no row fill. Hover (and keyboard active) fills the row only — text color does not change. No native fallback, multi-select, combobox typing, or optgroups. Prefer `Label` + `htmlFor`. `fill` stretches the trigger. Not a layout shell.

## MultiSelect

Custom multi listbox (not `multiple` on `Select`). Same field chrome, portal menu, and `defaults.select` as `Select`. Host owns `value` / `onChange` (`string[]`; empty array when cleared). The trigger shows a count (`2 selected`) — single line, no chips, English caption. The menu stays open while toggling. Each row is a `Checkbox` plus label; checked rows use `color` (primary) for the label, matching `Select`. Hover fills the row only. `clearable` is clear-all. `required` blocks an empty set (cannot uncheck the last). `selectedAtTop` lists checked options first (host order within groups); the highlight follows the same value after a toggle. `readOnly` opens to inspect without toggle / clear (not dimmed; row checkboxes stay enabled visually). No `emptyOption`. `name` writes one hidden input per value (`value=''` when empty, `required` on that input). Pointer: clear, caret-toggle close, and click-outside **blur** the trigger (toggles do not). Keyboard toggle / Escape keep focus. Tab away closes the menu. Keyboard: arrows, Enter / Space toggle, Escape on the trigger (not `window`), Home, End, type-ahead; Backspace / Delete clears when clearable. Type-ahead while **closed** opens and highlights (does not toggle). Disabled options are skipped. CSS chevron on the trigger. Prefer `Label` + `htmlFor`. `fill` stretches the trigger. Not a layout shell.

## Switch

`<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`. Native `checked` / `defaultChecked` / `onChange` — host owns the value. **`color` is the on-track chroma** (`primary` / `secondary` / `accent` / status; theme default `primary`). Off-track mixes panel text into `--panelize-bg` until `background`. Thumb is `defaults.switch.ink` (`palette.white`) until `ink`. Pair a visible name with `Label htmlFor`. No `label` / `children`. No `fill`. `size` is the type token (`extraSmall` … `extraLarge`). Track height is that size × theme `lineHeight` (keep `lineHeight` unitless, default `1.2`). Width is type × `defaults.switch.widthFactor` (default `2`). Thumb is height − 2×inset (`insetFactor` × type, default `0.2`). Pair with a `Label` of the **same** `size`. On-track hover/active use the `color` slot (same steps as `Button`). Instance `width` / `height` are space tokens or CSS and override those axes. Instance `borderRadius` (theme default `999px` capsule) shapes the track; the thumb uses `min(that, 50%)` so a capsule stays round and `small` / `none` squares both. `onChange` is the action (`event.currentTarget.checked`). Native `disabled` dims like `Button`. `:focus-visible` uses the on-track chroma glow (same mix as fields). Not a layout shell.

## Checkbox

`<input type="checkbox">`. Native `checked` / `defaultChecked` / `onChange` — host owns the value. **`color` is the chroma slot** (`primary` / `secondary` / `accent` / status; theme default `primary`), same steps as `Button`. Empty rest / hover / active stroke is `currentColor` (wrapping `Label` ink, else panel `text.base`) until `borderColor`. Checked / indeterminate fill the `color` slot’s `.base` / `.hover` / `.active`. Rest fill is transparent until `background`. Check / dash is `defaults.checkbox.ink` (`palette.black`, same as filled `Button`) until `ink` (token/CSS or `{ base, hover, active }`; hover/active unused on the mark). Pair a visible name with `Label htmlFor`. No `label` / `children`. No `fill`. `size` is the type token; the box is that size (`1em`, square). Pair with a `Label` of the **same** `size`. Instance `width` / `height` are space tokens or CSS. Instance `borderRadius` (theme default `small`) and `borderWidth` (theme default `extraSmall`, `1px`) override the theme. `indeterminate` is the native property (dash); it does not set `checked`. `hideCheckIcon` is fill-only when checked (no check glyph); the dash still draws when indeterminate. Empty `disabled` keeps the inherited stroke (pair with a muted wrapping `Label`); checked / indeterminate still dim like `Button`. Disabled skips hover. `:focus-visible` uses the on-fill chroma glow. Not a layout shell.

## Radio

`<input type="radio">`. Native `name` / `value` / `checked` / `defaultChecked` / `onChange` — host owns the group. **`color` is the chroma slot** (`primary` / `secondary` / `accent` / status; theme default `primary`), same steps as `Button`. Empty rest / hover / active stroke is `currentColor` (wrapping `Label` ink, else panel `text.base`) until `borderColor`. Checked ring and inner disc use the `color` slot’s `.base` / `.hover` / `.active`. Rest fill stays transparent until `background` so the panel shows in the gap around the disc. `ink` is the disc (`PaintSteps`, same as `Checkbox`); omit = disc follows `color` including hover/active. Pair a visible name with a wrapping `Label htmlFor`. No `label` / `children`. No `fill`. `size` is the type token; the box is that size (`1em`, circle). Pair with a `Label` of the **same** `size`. Disc inset is type × `defaults.radio.insetFactor` (default `0.22`). Instance `width` / `height` are space tokens or CSS. Instance `borderRadius` (theme default `999px` circle) shapes the ring; the disc uses `min(that, 50%)`. Instance `borderWidth` (theme default `extraSmall`, `1px`) overrides the theme. Empty `disabled` keeps the inherited stroke (pair with a muted wrapping `Label`); checked still dims like `Button`. Disabled skips hover. `:focus-visible` uses the on-ring chroma glow. Not a layout shell.

## Label

`<label>`. Ink like `Text` (`color` / `muted` / `highlighted`). The line box hugs the glyphs (`line-height: 1` and `text-box: trim-both cap alphabetic`, same idea as `Heading`) so a `Switch` / `Checkbox` / `Radio` in a centered `Cols` row lines up. Fields use `ink` for glyphs; field `color` is focus chroma only. Caption: `label` (preferred). Custom insides: `children` — they win if both are set. Point `htmlFor` at the control’s `id`. Cursor is `pointer` when `htmlFor` / `onClick` is set or the label wraps a control (`button` / `input` / `select` / `textarea`). Wrap the control (not a sibling-only `htmlFor`) so a `disabled` target is `not-allowed` via `:has(:disabled)`. Field labels stay `pointer`; the field itself keeps `text` / `not-allowed`.

---

<!-- docs/components.md -->

# Components

One line per export from `'panelize'`. Prop details are in the exported prop types (IDE hover) and the [README](../README.md). Layout props are in [layout](layout.md). Every component takes React `style` and `css?: string` (appended last).

## Layout

| Component | Element        | Direct parent                                             | Notes                                                                                    |
| --------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Panels`  | `div`          | any                                                       | View shell. Children: only `Panel`. `fill`, `horizontal`, `relative`, `scroll`, `stack`. |
| `Panel`   | `div`          | `Panels`, or a `Cell` / `Col` / `Row` for its own surface | Section. `variant` `muted` / `base` / `highlighted`. One item, or a track for several.   |
| `Rows`    | `div` (column) | any                                                       | Children: two or more `Row`. `gap`, `wrap`, `alignX` / `alignY`.                         |
| `Row`     | `div`          | `Rows`                                                    | `height` defaults to `auto`.                                                             |
| `Cols`    | `div` (row)    | any                                                       | Children: two or more `Col`. `gap`, `wrap`, `stack`.                                     |
| `Col`     | `div`          | `Cols`                                                    | `width` defaults to `auto`.                                                              |
| `Grid`    | `div` (grid)   | any                                                       | Children: two or more `Cell`. `numCols`, `numRows`, `stack`, `stackCols`.                |
| `Cell`    | `div`          | `Grid`                                                    | `spanX` / `spanY`. No `width` / `height` / `fill`.                                       |
| `Div`     | `div`          | any                                                       | Wrapper for one item (several → `Rows` / `Cols`). No background or color.                |

## Type

| Component  | Element   | Notes                                                                                                     |
| ---------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Text`     | `p`       | `muted` / `highlighted` / `color` / `size` / `weight` / `family` / `italic` / `underlined` / `uppercase`. |
| `Heading`  | `h1`–`h6` | Required `level`. Same type props as `Text`.                                                              |
| `Span`     | `span`    | Inline. Inherits size / weight / family from a parent `Text` / `Span`.                                    |
| `TextLink` | `a`       | `color`, `hover`, `hoverUnderline`. Native `href`.                                                        |
| `Label`    | `label`   | `label` or `children`, `htmlFor`. Wrap `Switch` / `Checkbox` / `Radio`.                                   |

`color` on type and controls: `primary` / `secondary` / `accent` (brand), `danger` / `warning` / `success` / `info` (status), or raw CSS.

## Controls

None is a layout shell. The wrapper (`Row` / `Col` / `Cell` / `Panel` / `Div`) places them.

| Component     | Element                        | Value API                                 | Notes                                                                       |
| ------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Button`      | `button`                       | `onClick`                                 | `label` or `children`. `color`, `outline`, `size`, `fill`, `disabled`.      |
| `Chip`        | `span`                         | none                                      | Badge, not a button. `label`, `color`.                                      |
| `Input`       | `input`                        | `value` / `onChange`                      | `color` is focus chroma. `ink` is text. Needs `Label` or `aria-label`.      |
| `NumberInput` | `input[type=number]`           | `value` / `onChange` (string)             | Use `event.currentTarget.valueAsNumber`.                                    |
| `Textarea`    | `textarea`                     | `value` / `onChange`                      | `resize` opt-in, `rows` default 3.                                          |
| `Select`      | custom listbox                 | `value: string` / `onChange(value)`       | `options` and/or `Option` children. `clearable`, `required`, `emptyOption`. |
| `MultiSelect` | custom multi listbox           | `value: string[]` / `onChange(value)`     | Count caption. Menu stays open while toggling.                              |
| `Option`      | child of selects               | `value`                                   | Label is `children`.                                                        |
| `Switch`      | `input[checkbox][role=switch]` | `checked` / `onChange`                    | `color` is the on track.                                                    |
| `Checkbox`    | `input[checkbox]`              | `checked` / `onChange`                    | `indeterminate`, `hideCheckIcon`.                                           |
| `Radio`       | `input[radio]`                 | `name` / `value` / `checked` / `onChange` | Host owns the group.                                                        |

`Switch` / `Checkbox` / `Radio` and their `Label` share one `size`. These three have no `fill`, `label`, or `children`.

## Theme

| Export                           | Purpose                                                                               |
| -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `createPanelizeTheme(overrides)` | Merge overrides onto the defaults. Keys: [theme keys](../examples/panelize.theme.md). |
| `PanelizeProvider`               | `theme` (optional) and `mode` `dark` (default) / `light`.                             |
| `usePanelizeTheme()`             | Active `colors`, `mode`, `brand`, `status`, scales, `defaults`.                       |
| `defaultTheme`                   | What components use without a provider.                                               |
| `palette`                        | Frozen gray ramp: `gray[0]`–`[6]`, `black`, `white`, `extraDark` … `extraLight`.      |

Tokens: space / border / radius `none` | `extraSmall` | `small` | `base` | `large` | `extraLarge`. Font size `extraSmall` … `extraLarge`. Weight `thin` | `base` | `bold` | `heavy`. Family `base` | `display` | `mono`. Breakpoints `sm` | `md` | `lg`.

---

<!-- docs/recipes.md -->

# Recipes

Copyable trees that follow [composition](composition.md). Pick the closest recipe, then change copy and tokens. Every tree sits inside `PanelizeProvider` and a host with `html` / `body` / `#root { height: 100% }`.

| Need                            | Recipe                                      |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| One scrolling page              | [Page](#page)                               |
| Sidebar plus main               | [Sidebar and main](#sidebar-and-main)       |
| Centered card (login, empty)    | [Centered card](#centered-card)             |
| Label above a field             | [Form fields](#form-fields)                 |
| Metric tiles that reflow        | [Dashboard grid](#dashboard-grid)           |
| Header bar, content, action row | [Header, body, footer](#header-body-footer) |

## Page

Scroll the shell. Inner `Panel` uses `minHeight='100%'`, not `fill`.

```tsx
<Panels fill scroll='vertical'>
  <Panel variant='muted' minHeight='100%' padding='base'>
    <Rows gap='base'>
      <Row>
        <Heading level={1}>Title</Heading>
      </Row>
      <Row>
        <Text muted>Long page copy…</Text>
      </Row>
    </Rows>
  </Panel>
</Panels>
```

## Sidebar and main

`horizontal` + `fill` on `Panels`. Sidebar gets `width`. Main gets `flex` and owns `scroll`. `stack` is "at most this wide → column".

```tsx
<Panels horizontal fill stack='sm'>
  <Panel variant='muted' width='14rem' padding='base'>
    <Rows gap='small'>
      <Row>
        <TextLink href='/'>Home</TextLink>
      </Row>
      <Row>
        <TextLink href='/settings'>Settings</TextLink>
      </Row>
    </Rows>
  </Panel>
  <Panel variant='base' flex scroll='vertical' padding='base'>
    <Heading level={2}>Main</Heading>
  </Panel>
</Panels>
```

## Centered card

Center on `Panels` (not scrolling). One `Panel` is the card.

```tsx
<Panels fill alignX='center' alignY='center'>
  <Panel variant='muted' width='24rem' padding='large' borderWidth='extraSmall' borderRadius='base'>
    <Rows gap='base'>
      <Row>
        <Heading level={2}>Sign in</Heading>
      </Row>
      <Row>
        <Button fill label='Continue' />
      </Row>
    </Rows>
  </Panel>
</Panels>
```

## Form fields

Each field is a `Rows` of two `Row`s (label, control). The outer `Rows` spaces the fields. Controls take `fill` to stretch themselves; the `Row` places them. Place the form inside a `Panel`.

```tsx
<Rows gap='base'>
  <Row>
    <Rows gap='extraSmall'>
      <Row>
        <Label htmlFor='email' label='Email' />
      </Row>
      <Row>
        <Input id='email' type='email' fill />
      </Row>
    </Rows>
  </Row>
  <Row>
    <Rows gap='extraSmall'>
      <Row>
        <Label htmlFor='plan' label='Plan' />
      </Row>
      <Row>
        <Select id='plan' value={plan} onChange={setPlan} fill>
          <Option value='hobby'>Hobby</Option>
          <Option value='pro'>Pro</Option>
        </Select>
      </Row>
    </Rows>
  </Row>
</Rows>
```

A toggle pairs with a **wrapping** `Label` of the same `size`:

```tsx
<Label htmlFor='auto-save'>
  <Switch id='auto-save' defaultChecked /> Auto-save drafts
</Label>
```

## Dashboard grid

`stack='md'` collapses to `stackCols` columns at most `md` wide. Each tile is a `Panel` because it wants its own surface (`variant='muted'`). If a tile can use the surrounding surface, put the `Rows` straight in the `Cell` and drop the `Panel`.

```tsx
<Grid numCols={3} stackCols={1} stack='md' gap='base'>
  <Cell>
    <Panel variant='muted' padding='base'>
      <Rows>
        <Row>
          <Text muted size='small'>
            Users
          </Text>
        </Row>
        <Row>
          <Heading level={3}>1,204</Heading>
        </Row>
      </Rows>
    </Panel>
  </Cell>
  <Cell>
    <Panel variant='muted' padding='base'>
      <Rows>
        <Row>
          <Text muted size='small'>
            Revenue
          </Text>
        </Row>
        <Row>
          <Heading level={3}>$8.4k</Heading>
        </Row>
      </Rows>
    </Panel>
  </Cell>
  <Cell>
    <Panel variant='muted' padding='base'>
      <Rows>
        <Row>
          <Text muted size='small'>
            Errors
          </Text>
        </Row>
        <Row>
          <Heading level={3}>3</Heading>
        </Row>
      </Rows>
    </Panel>
  </Cell>
</Grid>
```

## Header, body, footer

A default `Panels` is a column. The body takes `flex` and scrolls; the bars keep their size.

```tsx
<Panels fill>
  <Panel variant='highlighted' padding='base' borderBottom='extraSmall'>
    <Heading level={2}>Project</Heading>
  </Panel>
  <Panel flex scroll='vertical' padding='base'>
    <Text>Body…</Text>
  </Panel>
  <Panel variant='muted' padding='base' borderTop='extraSmall'>
    <Cols gap='small' alignX='end'>
      <Col>
        <Button outline label='Cancel' />
      </Col>
      <Col>
        <Button label='Save' />
      </Col>
    </Cols>
  </Panel>
</Panels>
```

---

<!-- examples/panelize.theme.md -->

# Theme keys

Every key `createPanelizeTheme` accepts. Omit any key to keep the library default.

```ts
import { createPanelizeTheme, palette } from 'panelize'

export const panelizeTheme = createPanelizeTheme({
  colors: {
    dark: {
      app: {
        background: '#121212',
        text: '#e8e8e8',
      },
      muted: {
        background: '#222222',
        text: {
          base: palette.gray.extraLight,
          muted: palette.gray.base,
          highlighted: palette.white,
        },
        border: palette.gray.dark,
      },
      base: {
        background: '#333333',
        text: {
          base: palette.gray.extraLight,
          muted: palette.gray.light,
          highlighted: palette.white,
        },
        border: palette.gray.base,
      },
      highlighted: {
        background: palette.gray.dark,
        text: {
          base: palette.white,
          muted: palette.gray.light,
          highlighted: palette.white,
        },
        border: palette.gray.base,
      },
    },
    light: {
      app: {
        background: '#fafafa',
        text: '#121212',
      },
      muted: {
        background: '#f2f2f2',
        text: {
          base: '#222222',
          muted: palette.gray.base,
          highlighted: palette.black,
        },
        border: palette.gray.light,
      },
      base: {
        background: '#f7f7f7',
        text: {
          base: '#333333',
          muted: palette.gray.base,
          highlighted: palette.black,
        },
        border: palette.gray.base,
      },
      highlighted: {
        background: palette.white,
        text: {
          base: palette.gray.dark,
          muted: palette.gray.base,
          highlighted: palette.black,
        },
        border: palette.gray.base,
      },
    },
  },
  brand: {
    primary: {
      base: '#ff9f2e',
      hover: '#ffb762',
      active: '#f1962b',
    },
    secondary: {
      base: '#ff9f2e',
      hover: '#ffb762',
      active: '#f1962b',
    },
    accent: {
      base: '#ff9f2e',
      hover: '#ffb762',
      active: '#f1962b',
    },
  },
  status: {
    danger: '#f2555a',
    warning: '#ffd60a',
    success: '#4ade80',
    info: '#38bdf8',
  },
  space: {
    none: '0rem',
    extraSmall: '0.25rem',
    small: '0.5rem',
    base: '1rem',
    large: '1.5rem',
    extraLarge: '2rem',
  },
  borderWidths: {
    none: '0',
    extraSmall: '1px',
    small: '2px',
    base: '4px',
    large: '8px',
    extraLarge: '12px',
  },
  breakpoints: {
    sm: '40rem',
    md: '48rem',
    lg: '64rem',
  },
  fontSizes: {
    extraSmall: '0.75rem',
    small: '0.875rem',
    base: '1rem',
    large: '1.25rem',
    extraLarge: '1.5rem',
  },
  fontWeights: {
    thin: '100',
    base: '400',
    bold: '700',
    heavy: '800',
  },
  fontFamilies: {
    base: '"Open Sans", sans-serif',
    display: 'Montserrat, sans-serif',
    mono: 'ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace',
  },
  // Unitless. `Text` leading. Switch track height is type × this. Checkbox / Radio use `1em`.
  lineHeight: 1.2,
  radii: {
    none: '0',
    extraSmall: '0.125rem',
    small: '0.25rem',
    base: '0.5rem',
    large: '0.75rem',
    extraLarge: '1rem',
  },
  defaults: {
    panel: {
      padding: 'none',
      margin: 'none',
      borderWidth: 'none',
      borderRadius: 'none',
    },
    panels: {
      padding: 'none',
      margin: 'none',
      gap: 'none',
    },
    // No panels.alignX / alignY: Panels is a column, or `horizontal` / `stack`.
    rows: {
      padding: 'none',
      margin: 'none',
      gap: 'none',
      alignX: 'stretch',
      alignY: 'start',
    },
    row: {
      padding: 'none',
      margin: 'none',
      height: 'auto',
      borderWidth: 'none',
      borderRadius: 'none',
    },
    cols: {
      padding: 'none',
      margin: 'none',
      gap: 'none',
      alignX: 'start',
      alignY: 'stretch',
    },
    col: {
      padding: 'none',
      margin: 'none',
      width: 'auto',
      borderWidth: 'none',
      borderRadius: 'none',
    },
    grid: {
      padding: 'none',
      margin: 'none',
      gap: 'none',
      alignX: 'stretch',
      alignY: 'stretch',
    },
    cell: {
      padding: 'none',
      margin: 'none',
      borderWidth: 'none',
      borderRadius: 'none',
    },
    div: {
      padding: 'none',
      margin: 'none',
      borderWidth: 'none',
      borderRadius: 'none',
    },
    text: {
      size: 'base',
      weight: 'base',
    },
    heading: {
      size: {
        1: '2rem',
        2: '1.5rem',
        3: '1.17rem',
        4: '1rem',
        5: '0.83rem',
        6: '0.67rem',
      },
      weight: 'bold',
      family: 'display',
    },
    textLink: {
      color: 'primary',
      hover: 'primary',
      hoverUnderline: false,
    },
    button: {
      color: 'primary',
      size: 'small',
      weight: 'bold',
      ink: palette.black,
      hover: { color: palette.black },
      paddingX: 'base',
      paddingY: 'small',
      gap: 'extraSmall',
      borderWidth: 'extraSmall',
      borderRadius: 'base',
    },
    chip: {
      color: 'primary',

      weight: 'bold',
      tint: '12%',
      paddingX: 'base',
      paddingY: 'extraSmall',
      gap: 'extraSmall',
      borderRadius: '999px',
      uppercase: true,
    },
    input: {
      color: 'primary',
      size: 'small',
      weight: 'base',
      paddingX: 'base',
      paddingY: 'small',
      borderWidth: 'extraSmall',
      borderRadius: 'base',
    },
    textarea: {
      color: 'primary',
      size: 'small',
      weight: 'base',
      paddingX: 'base',
      paddingY: 'small',
      borderWidth: 'extraSmall',
      borderRadius: 'base',
      resize: false,
      rows: 3,
    },
    select: {
      color: 'primary',
      size: 'small',
      weight: 'base',
      paddingX: 'base',
      paddingY: 'small',
      borderWidth: 'extraSmall',
      borderRadius: 'base',
      listMaxHeight: '16rem',
      listOffset: 'extraSmall',

    },
  },
})
```
